messages:
maya: heads up — during tenant onboarding in staging I'm seeing repeated SCIM 403s for service accounts after the RBAC cleanup deploy. externalId is blank for some entries.
jess: which deploy? paste error snippet and the provisioning payload?
maya: rolled role-mapping at 09:11. logs: `scim: provision failed status=403 body="forbidden: access denied" externalId=""`. also KMS decrypt errors: `kms: decrypt failed: context mismatch for alias/redwood-provisioner`
samir: context mismatch = wrap ctx changed. did the RBAC change rename principals used to derive extid?
maya: yes, we normalized role names (lowercase + strip domain). extid is `svc/${tenant}/${role}` — normalization changed the string.
leo: can you dump a failing `envhdr` (envelope header) without keys?
maya: posted secure log: `envhdr: alg=A256GCM, ctx="tenant=acme;svc=payments;role=BillingAdmin"` ciphertext truncated.
jess: that ctx still has old casing; we removed NameQualifier earlier, mapper fallback may be using legacy format.
samir: unwrap uses normalized role, so KMS rejects old wrapped data. two paths: rewrap or accept both ctx values temporarily.
security-bot: [vuln-triage] potential broken access control for onboarded service accounts. severity=S1 if prod affected.
maya: mitigation in staging: reverted normalization; started a re-onboard job to rewrap extids with the old ctx — cleared ~70% failures.
leo: temporary ok. long term: controlled rewrap to canonical context + update downstream caches, and log ctx fingerprint on wrap/unwrap for audit.
jess: also check SAML NameID changes — found assertions where NameQualifier dropped and Format changed. snippet: `<saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">svc-payments@example.com</saml:NameID>` downstream mappers expected `idp.entityId:nameid`.
samir: that explains correlation loss: SCIM expects `externalId = idp|nameid|role`. losing idp prefix changes ctx.
maya: action items: 1) run full rewrap in staging to canonicalize extids, 2) support compatibility unwrap for 48h, 3) emit audit event with ctx fingerprint on wrap/unwrap, 4) draft postmortem.
jess: I'll open a short rollback incident and notify support + oncall for prod onboarding.
ops-bot: deployed rollback of role-normalization at 09:23 — canary passed.
security-bot: coordinate KMS key rotation with SRE before rewrap; rotation + rewrap order is critical.
leo: add a Redwood Optimize eval to detect extid drift on onboarding: metric = empty externalId per 1k provisioning events.
samir: postmortem should include timeline, root cause (ctx derived from role canonicalization), mitigations, and permanent fix (wrap contract + audit).
maya: I'll paste notes and repro script into the incident doc and tag affected tenants when available. closing loop after rewrap run completes. :white_check_mark:
